message.content: I’m happy to help you find the best move! Could you please share the current board position? You can give me the FEN notation or describe the pieces on the board (e.g., “White has a king on e1, queen on d1, rooks on a1 and h1, bishops on c1 and f1, knights on b1 and g1, pawns on a2–h2; Black has a king on e8, queen on d8, rooks on a8 and h8, bishops on c8 and f8, knights on b8 and g8, pawns on a7–h7” etc.). Once I know the exact setup, I can calculate the best move for White.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What is the best chess move for white player in this position?" We need to respond with the best move. But we don't have the board position. There's no board diagram or description. So we cannot answer. According to policy, if insufficient info, we should ask clarifying question. Also we can offer to analyze if they provide FEN or description. So we should ask them to provide the board position.
